activity_summary: You went in to the old play. You were in the house. You did not name the man. Heminges refused a sum at the door. You played, and you came home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a new name, and went in.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Opened the doors on the old play.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Would not count the yard from the step.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Kept the book shut until he had it.

entities.name: the old Hamlet
entities.context: Mentioned in In the house, and no new name

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not giving the afternoon a new name on the way in
